summary: Simplify the ZFS storage wizard to a two-screen dialog and tidy the Storage page: repository list first, advanced panels folded. UI only. API impact: existing contract (storage/discover kind zfs-device and storage/zfs/provision are called with the same request shapes; scope is derived from the ticked hosts).

guide.reason: The operator steps, screen names and button labels for provisioning ZFS storage and adding a host to an existing repository changed.

api.reason: No Controller, Core or peer operation changed. The dialog sends the same discovery and provisioning requests; an automatic layout is still omitted so Core chooses it.

roadmap.reason: Presentation of an already-listed capability; no milestone or status change.

state.reason: No durable state is added. The dialog keeps only a per-tab session draft of name, ticked hosts, layout choice and request identity; repository identity and outcomes remain Core-owned.

verification.method: Typecheck, UI unit checks, four simulated browser harnesses and a read-only real-Controller walkthrough in a disposable lab; limits are recorded in the report.
